definition.name: Orison · maintained service
definition.description: Tern visits a perturbed relay and returns. Station corrections and both flight legs are solved as the service runs.
definition.provenance: Online bounded finite-force targeting against immutable canonical station forecasts. Paired visit/return admission; no relay exchange or attached station thrust. Finite ship/maintenance tanks; explicit fuel imports at the ballistic origin. Memory-only rolling history.
